selected.name: Cover, the dressed shoemaker
selected.display_text: Cover is dressed. He wears a coat, waistcoat, and trousers, and has boots upon his feet. He is bareheaded, and has no other covering upon his head. He is young, and has the appearance of being in good health. He is not remarkable in any way, and has no peculiarity of dress. He is a native of England, and has no other language than his own. He is a shoemaker by trade, and has never been out of Europe. He has never been in any kind of covering, except dress.

selected.name: Spirit existing from all eternity
selected.display_text: I am a spirit, and have existed from all eternity. In the beginning I was with God. I am immortal, and can never die. The heaven is my abiding place, and the earth is my footstool. I am invisible to the natural eye, but I am seen by the eye of faith. I am distinct from matter, and can have no fellowship with it. Spiritually I am married to Christ, and my business is to bear witness of him to the world.
